1.title: Why Chatbots Are the Wrong Interface for Work | Arnab Bose
1.author: MTS
1.hook: Asana's CPO discusses why chatbots fail for work, presents agentic work management platform with shared context and memory, shows enterprise bottleneck reduction and task auto-evaluation.

2.title: Why DC Views Superintelligence as a National Security Threat
2.author: MTS
2.hook: Sam Hammond (Foundation for American Innovation) on how Washington is reframing AI as a national security issue — the Superintelligence Task Force, model weight security, antitrust defenses for lab coordination, and recruiting tech talent to government.
